主要内容: This document is a Form 6-K filing by Brookfield Asset Management Inc., dated February 26, 2013. It incorporates by reference the Form 6-K and its exhibits into the registration statement on Form F-9 (File No. 333-112049). The filing includes an announcement of the appointment of Douglas Kirkman by Brookfield and Investment Corporation of Dubai. The document is signed by B. D. Lawson, who is identified as the Managing Partner & CFO of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. The filing is submitted in compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
